articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.snippet: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
articles.snippet: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

articles.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
articles.snippet: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward and its clients buy AAVE tokens in DeFi investment push
articles.snippet: The investment follows talks first reported by CoinDesk in June that included a proposed equity stake in Aave Group.
